title: Document that a resolved task folder's embedded inventory fingerprint may be resolved either way after a Git merge
outcome: Document that a resolved task folder's embedded inventory fingerprint may be resolved either way after a Git merge
acceptance: docs/features/task-planning-text.md states that importing a resolved folder reads its inventory from the task files and ignores project.json's embedded export_basis inventory_fingerprint, so a Git conflict on that line can be resolved by taking either side (or any well-formed value), and names where the fingerprint is still checked (task-sync prepare/setup candidates and --basis files)
a test pins that a resolved folder whose project.json carries a stale or the other host's inventory_fingerprint imports exactly as with its own
